role: Safe, rounding conversion of date intervals to Int64 milliseconds, rejecting NaN/infinite/±100-year values.

units.does: Rounded ms between two dates, nil if unrepresentable.
Rounded ms between two dates; when unrepresentable, logs a warning-level debugLog naming the fallback and returns the caller's fallback.

branches.effect: logs a warning ('[MillisecondOffset] interval not representable … using fallback') and returns fallback (callers pass 0, e.g. SessionMerger.swift)

units.contract: Returns the rounded milliseconds between the two dates; when the interval is not representable it logs a warning naming the fallback and returns the caller's fallback. It never fails or returns nil.

units.does: seconds*1000 rounded to Int64 when within ±100 years, else nil (NaN fails both comparisons).
